segmentation: Strict concatenation of dediacritized bw morphemes to surface; merge adjacent identical span types; a standalone function word is a stem. Unalignable analyses are rejected and counted in mapping-audit.json.
preserved: Every distinct mappable teacher analysis, including internal missing states and lemma family, is retained.
patterns: Closed classes derived from training only, at most 64 common patterns; unseen/rare patterns become unknown.
limitations: Surface-alignment filtering can bias the corpus away from orthographic alternations. Teacher sampling is not natural-distribution evaluation. Human audit is pending. Diacritic distinctions are ignored by the first student.
